name: JFrogEvidence
description: Evidence for an artifact or Release Bundle
author: JFrog

inputs.name: artifactoryConnection
inputs.label: Artifactory service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select the Artifactory service connection to use for this task.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working Directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: The working directory where the command will run. When empty, the value of '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)' is used.

inputs.name: predicateFilePath
inputs.label: Predicate file path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the Predicate, arbitrary JSON. Mandatory unless 'Sigstore bundle' is used.

inputs.name: predicateType
inputs.label: Predicate type
inputs.helpMarkDown: Type of the Predicate. Mandatory unless 'Sigstore bundle' is used.

inputs.name: markdownFilePath
inputs.label: Markdown file path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Markdown of the Predicate.

inputs.name: integration
inputs.label: Integration
inputs.helpMarkDown: Specify an integration to automatically generate the Predicate. Supported: 'sonar'. When using 'sonar', the 'SONAR_TOKEN' or 'SONARQUBE_TOKEN' environment variable must be set

inputs.name: sigstoreBundle
inputs.label: Sigstore bundle file path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to a Sigstore bundle file with a pre-signed DSSE envelope. Incompatible with 'Key', 'Key alias', 'Predicate', 'Predicate type' and 'Subject SHA256'.

inputs.name: keyFilePath
inputs.label: Key file path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to a private key that will sign the DSSE. Supported keys: 'ecdsa', 'rsa' and 'ed25519'.

inputs.name: keyAlias
inputs.label: Key alias
inputs.helpMarkDown: Key alias.

inputs.name: subjectType
inputs.label: Subject type
inputs.helpMarkDown: The subject the evidence is attached to.

inputs.name: buildName
inputs.label: Build name
inputs.helpMarkDown:
Build name.
To use the default build name of the pipeline, set the field to '$(Build.DefinitionName)'.
The build should already be published to Artifactory.

inputs.name: buildNumber
inputs.label: Build number
inputs.helpMarkDown:
Build number.
To use the default build number of the pipeline, set the field to '$(Build.BuildNumber)'.
The build should already be published to Artifactory.

inputs.name: releaseBundleName
inputs.label: Release Bundle name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Release Bundle name.

inputs.name: releaseBundleVersion
inputs.label: Release Bundle version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Release Bundle version.

inputs.name: packageName
inputs.label: Package name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Package name.

inputs.name: packageRepoName
inputs.label: Package repository name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Package repository name.

inputs.name: packageVersion
inputs.label: Package version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Package version.

inputs.name: applicationKey
inputs.label: Application key
inputs.helpMarkDown: Application key.

inputs.name: applicationVersion
inputs.label: Application version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Application version.

inputs.name: subjectRepoPath
inputs.label: Subject repository path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Full path to some subject location, in the format <repo/path>.

inputs.name: subjectSha256
inputs.label: Subject SHA256
inputs.helpMarkDown: Subject checksum sha256.

inputs.name: attachmentSource
inputs.label: Attachment source
inputs.helpMarkDown: The source of a file to attach to the created evidence.

inputs.name: attachLocalFilePath
inputs.label: Local file path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to a local file to attach to the created evidence.

inputs.name: attachArtifactoryTempPath
inputs.label: Artifactory temp upload path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Temporary Artifactory upload path for the local file, in the format <repo/path[/name]>. Use trailing slash for directory targets.

inputs.name: attachArtifactoryPath
inputs.label: Artifactory file path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Existing Artifactory file path to attach, in the format <repo/path>.

inputs.name: providerId
inputs.label: Provider ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: Provider ID for the evidence.

inputs.name: evidenceType
inputs.label: Type
inputs.helpMarkDown: Type can contain 'gh-commiter' value.

inputs.name: format
inputs.label: Output format
inputs.helpMarkDown: Defines the output format of the command.

inputs.name: projectKey
inputs.label: Project key
inputs.helpMarkDown: The JFrog Project key associated with the created evidence.
